Plants of the World Online account: Anacamptis × olida (Bréb.) H.Kretzschmar, Eccarius & H.Dietr..

The native range of this hybrid is Europe. It is a tuberous geophyte and grows primarily in the subtropical biome. The hybrid formula is A. coriophora × A. morio.
